full_name: Susan Moller Okin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Susan Moller Okin, the Marta Sutton Weeks Professor of Ethics in Society and a professor of political science at Stanford University, is a political theorist whose work has focused on the exclusion of women from most Western political thought, past and present.
